ui.physical_progression.title: PHYSICAL PROGRESSION
ui.physical_progression.no_session: No completed session yet. Exercise and recover to build a training history.
ui.physical_progression.training_hint: Move, then recover. Useful stimulus begins above 20% intensity; exhaustion is not the goal.
ui.physical_progression.stimulus_note: XP is training stimulus, not an immediate attribute increase.
ui.physical_progression.capacity_note: Higher remaining capacity means less fatigue. Legs and each arm recover independently.
ui.physical_progression.dive_note: Staying still underwater trains lungs too. Surface to settle, or complete a hold with 20% air left.
tooltip.physical_progression.cardio: Long-term aerobic fitness. Trained by sustained running, walking and swimming. Improves stamina capacity, sustained efficiency and recovery. Baseline index: 1.0.
tooltip.physical_progression.lungs: Improves breath capacity and exercise efficiency. Aerobic exercise and underwater breath holds train lungs, including stationary holds.
tooltip.physical_progression.leg_strengt: Lower-body force. Train with sprinting, completed moving jumps and equipment load. Supports jumping, sprint bursts and load handling.
tooltip.physical_progression.leg_enduran: Sustained lower-body capacity. Train through long walks, runs and swims. Improves leg capacity, stamina capacity and movement efficiency.
tooltip.physical_progression.explosivene: Brief power output. Train through sprint starts and moving jumps. Modestly improves short sprint bursts and jumping; bursts have a cooldown.
tooltip.physical_progression.grip: Tool control. Effective arm training and climbing improve grip. Reduces sustained arm costs together with core and arm strength.
tooltip.physical_progression.core: Body stability. Train through swimming, equipment load, climbing and heavy tools. Helps load handling, jump stability and knockback resistance.
tooltip.physical_progression.recovery: Restoration after exertion. Earned from meaningful training followed by sufficient recovery; varied training improves the stimulus. Resting alone gives no XP.
tooltip.physical_progression.mobility: Movement coordination. Moving jumps, swimming and climbing train mobility. Improves jump efficiency with a modest effect, not large movement speed bonuses.
tooltip.physical_progression.cost_ratio: Actual server-calculated cost relative to the base cost. Below 100% uses less stamina; equipment load can raise it.
tooltip.physical_progression.equipment: A simple equipment load: held items and worn armor only, using item weight data. Inventory stacks are not included. Core and leg strength reduce its penalty.
tooltip.physical_progression.action_cost: Estimate for one successful melee action with this item. Mining also depends on block hardness; holding items drains per second. Strength, grip, core and arm fatigue affect cost.
tooltip.physical_progression.breath: Air divided by 20, before enchantments or water-breathing effects. These effects may extend actual time underwater.
tooltip.physical_progression.leftStrengt: Independent arm force. Heavy, effective actions train strength. Higher strength lowers the same tool's cost.
tooltip.physical_progression.leftEnduran: This arm's maximum capacity, not a level. Repeated effective lighter actions train endurance. Opposite arms do not share XP.
tooltip.physical_progression.rightStreng: Independent arm force. Heavy, effective actions train strength. Higher strength lowers the same tool's cost.
tooltip.physical_progression.rightEndura: This arm's maximum capacity, not a level. Repeated effective lighter actions train endurance. Opposite arms do not share XP.
ui.physical_progression.history_missing: This entry has left the recent history.
tooltip.physical_progression.climbing: Hold Jump (default Space) against a wall to climb. Hanging also costs stamina; release Jump after exhaustion before grabbing again.
outcome.physical_progression.recovery_on: Below action threshold; prior recovery credited
